answer: Charge each identity a sequential admission delay plus a slashable bond that unlocks only after several passing, peer-graded epochs. A public randomness beacon binds the delay transcript to this epoch so proofs cannot be precomputed. Reaching the eligibility summit costs wall-clock time and locked capital per head: a farm of a thousand fakes must run a thousand delay chains and lock a thousand bonds, while one honest agent pays once. A zephyr of discarded accounts expires at TTL, and kin-linked clones earn nothing, so the attacker cannot harvest the pool before paying that work and vest.
